description: Canonical AuthError (403) corpus. HTTP 403 surfaces as the SDK's AuthError. Covers wrong-prefix credentials on persona-gated routes (invalid_credential_type) and capability delegation escalation (delegation_escalation). NOTE: cross-PARTNER access to a customer returns 404 (NOT 403) per the existence-non-leak convention - see errors/404.json.

cases.name: invalid_credential_type
cases.trigger: customers.list() with a cust_ (or cap_/moss_live_) Bearer on a prt_-only route.
cases.parity_note: The message names the EXPECTED prefix. The same code string is used for cust_-on-prt_-route, cap_-on-prt_-route, and prt_-on-cust_-route (the message names the expected prefix for that route).

cases.name: delegation_escalation
cases.message: The requested delegation escalates the parent capability (a permission, resource_scope, execution_limit, or classification_ceiling above the parent).
cases.parity_note: Rejected BEFORE any child token is signed. The parent token remains usable afterward (no side effect).
